definitions.full: H4950. mishqa [ מִשְׁקָע ] noun [masculine] what is settled, clarified (compare √ Hiph`il ); — construct תִּשְׁתּו מִשְׁקַעמַֿיִם Ezek 34:18 the clear (of) water ye drink (compare 32:14 above). [ שְׁקַעֲרוּרָה ] see פער .
